nodes.summary: Implement the relational persistence contract for the ledger.
nodes.instructions:
Implement the declared database contract through the shipped persistence library. Declare the
three tables, integer-cent amounts, primary and foreign keys, and repository operations needed
by initialization, loading, account commands, transaction commands, transfers, and reports.
Do not open a database driver from application code.
nodes.name: Implement the relational persistence contract for the ledger.

nodes.summary: Provide the executable ledger command and command validation.
nodes.instructions:
Create the executable ledger at the application root and route commands to application services.
Resolve DATABASE_URL, then DATABASE_PATH, then data/app.db. Enforce argument validation and map
success, operational, usage, rejection, and not-found outcomes to the specified exit codes.
Successful output is CSV; failures write no standard output and one diagnostic line to standard
error.
nodes.name: Provide the executable ledger command and command validation.

acceptance.intent: The executable dispatches a supported command and returns its successful exit status.
An unknown command is reported as a usage error without standard output.
DATABASE_URL takes precedence over DATABASE_PATH when selecting the store.

balance checks, and atomic rollback. Preserve loaded IDs and reject the supplied invalid fixture
without storing any part of it.
